note: The audit's known items (ADR 1012): classes the audit reports and a person has seen, with the EXACT IDS they hold by recall mode (audit-proved.mjs applyKnown). A reported id an entry stores leaves the audit's needs-a-look list; an id it does not store is attention (a new item, or a swap for a fixed one); a stored id no longer reported is attention too (a fix is news: remove it); `cap` entries accept any subset of their ids. Any change but removing ids (a new entry, an added id, a changed idRegex or cap) needs a new ADR (scripts/guard/proved.mjs).
